sortieLines.line: ⚔️ SORTIE — Trong, Aroha, Victor take up arms and a day's rations (6,012 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ The Big Ugly mauled Trong (-99 health) over 4 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — the party falls back to the palisade, dragging their nerve with them. The treeline holds.

🌙 Night. The lingering Big Ugly gorges at the treeline — 800 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
